name: Egens binorum
gloss: the needy one, of a pair
wiring_note: THE ONLY MEASURED SUPERADDITIVITY IN THE PROJECT. frame acts at shape, readout at read, and neither does anything alone. This is the counterexample to reading every marginal null as a verdict: a lattice CAN see a whole that exceeds its parts, and here it did.

fuel.law: IV. Also measured on nvidia/meta/llama-3.2-1b-instruct with the same result.

receipt.claim: two rungs jointly necessary; neither alone does anything at all
receipt.measured: frame alone 0/8, readout alone has nothing to read, both together 8/8, at every temperature tested
receipt.why_it_matters: a player who seats one part, sees no change and concludes the part is worthless has learned exactly the wrong thing
